html:
SMTO-CMP-0022 — The AI didn't say up front whether you'd get a final reply

GUID: d2128388-e1a0-415e-95ef-b11f0f5b230f
Slug: completion-output-contract-missing
Domain: CMP · Subsystem: cmp

What happened

  • At the start of a task, the AI model must say whether it will end with a written reply. It tried to finish without doing that, so SMTO asked it to correct this. Work already done is kept.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Give the task a moment. SMTO normally sends this back to the AI, and the task continues on its own. This is a missing detail in the AI's reply, not a problem with the work.
  2. If the task shows Partial · resumable, select Resume on the task. SMTO asks the AI to record the reply choice and finish, keeping work already done.
  3. If you want a specific ending, such as a full summary, say so in the message box under the task and send it. A message from you sets whether the task ends with a written reply.
  4. If this keeps happening, ask the person who manages SMTO to try a different Main model in Settings › Setup › Model routing. This step is the AI model's job, and some models skip it more often.

What success looks like

  • The task shows Completed with the kind of final reply you expected.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, noting which model the task used. Check whether the earlier action already happened before anything is repeated. Don't restart the task; its finished work doesn't need to run again.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Output assessment found the terminal_output_contract key present but still null, so no output contract was established before a success declaration (reason output_contract_missing).

What this means

  • Output assessment finds the contract key present with an unresolved null value. Completion checks consume retained evidence and the effective guard policy; they do not execute work. A rejected declaration preserves the answer and successful receipts, and only the original operation evidence establishes effects.

Why this can happen

  • Output assessment finds the contract key present with an unresolved null value.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the initial output declaration and accepted contract lifecycle.

How to fix it

  • Inspect terminal_output_contract in the run state and whether the model's first decision included __smto_terminal_output (initialize and _assess_output in src/agent_runtime/native/output_contract.py). Resume so the model establishes none or required and then completes; a user steering message can also set it. The completion.output_contract Agent Check governs enforcement.
  • Restore or establish the accepted output contract before declaring completion.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect and reconcile authoritative state before repeating a mutation. Do not blindly retry.

How to verify the fix

  • The supported declaration establishes the intended output contract before terminal assessment.

What not to do

  • Do not repeat a mutation while the earlier outcome or current owner is unresolved.

Technical notes

  • Completion checks consume retained evidence and the effective guard policy; they do not execute work. A rejected declaration preserves the answer and successful receipts, and only the original operation evidence establishes effects.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-EXE-0004 — Execution outcome is unknown
